svg.text: · more, smaller departments = fine-grained experts (DeepSeekMoE): the activation ratio falls
· a front desk every patient passes = the shared expert
· transfers between hospitals = all-to-all communication across devices — the real engineering bottleneck (W11)
· the desk learns favourites: a department that is chosen trains more, and gets chosen more — others starve (collapse)
· "which department" is a discrete choice: no gradient through the selection, only through the gate value
· departments are not medical specialities: Mixtral's routing follows syntax and position more than topic (§5)
